one_sentence_story: After viral brain damage erased Eugene Pauly's conscious memory of his own house, his deep habit engine in the basal ganglia still walked him straight to the kitchen cabinet on autopilot.
so_what_for_you: Trying to break a bad habit by pure willpower mid-routine rarely works because the start cue has already launched a chunked striatal bracket; swap the routine attached to the cue instead.
